title: lonicera japonica var. repens
intro: Lonicera japonica var. repens, commonly known as Japanese Honeysuckle or Climbing Honeysuckle, is a woody vine native to East Asia, characterized by its evergreen foliage and fragrant white flowers. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lonicera japonica var. repens include expectorant, antiussive, and antipyretic effects, which help relieve congestion, cough, and fever. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
